display_information.name: gm-bot
display_information.long_description:
Here's what I can help with:

Market Data & Signals
• Z-score anomaly signals (volume, OI, funding, liquidations, IV) for any supported token — "what's unusual in SOL today?"
• Spot price history and performance over any window up to 120 days
• Perpetual futures: funding rates, open interest, perp volume, liquidations
• Options (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE on Deribit): implied vol, term structure, skew, put/call ratios, dealer gamma, block flow
• Full written market reports per token

Desk Book (A1 / OTC)
• Live portfolio risk snapshot: delta, gamma, vega, theta, gross/net notional
• PnL history — by day, strategy or venue (day / WTD / MTD / YTD / LTD)
• Greeks history and trend
• Perp positions: what we're running, size, funding PnL, entry vs mark
• Exposure by underlying (e.g. "what's our ETH risk?")
• OTC derivatives trades (blotter, last N days)
• Open orders on Talos
• Internal asset prices (live tick + intraday path)
• Ad-hoc BigQuery queries on brokerage_a1 and pricing datasets

What I can't do
• Custody / HOLD balances, CRMS, lending, reporting datasets — no access
• Tokens outside the supported universe (use list_token_universe to check)
• Options data for tokens not listed on Deribit
• Any write operations or trade execution

Ask me anything in the areas above — I'll always pull live data, never guess.
